intended_object: The explicit cardinality of the Lubell frame on [t]: Σ_{j=2}^{t} C(t,j)·M_t/C(t−1,j−1), where M_t = lcm{C(t−1,r) : 1≤r≤t−1}. Inferred from the docstring and from the lemma at line 525 that the library proves about it, (lubellFrame t).card = lubellCardSum t.
explanation: The body sums C(t,j)·lubellMultiplicity t j over j ∈ [2,t], which is exactly the size of the Lubell multiset: each j-subset of [t] appears M_t/C(t−1,j−1) times. Natural-number division loses nothing here, because 1 ≤ j−1 ≤ t−1 makes C(t−1,j−1) a term of the lcm, so it divides M_t (the file proves this as M_dvd). The library proves that this sum equals the frame's cardinality. It is a specific combinatorial quantity whose only parameter is t : ℕ, so it cannot be too narrow, and Mathlib has no counterpart.
